about: The raw per-sector engine outputs of indep_d1 (engine/runs/<run>/*.cfg.json; their sha256 in RAW_SHA256SUMS.txt) are not in the repository. They are hosted in the project's Zenodo data record as one deterministic tar.gz (GNU tar --sort=name, owner/group 0, mtime 2026-10-18; gzip -n -9), unpacking to engine/runs/<run>/. Record: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23466766 (files at https://zenodo.org/records/23466766/files/<hosted_name>). make -f public.mk fetch-data downloads, checks and unpacks it into .work/raw; replay-raw needs it.

files.needed_by: replay-raw (the assembly from the raw per-sector outputs; the pooled record rebuilt and compared)
